definitions: Showing an ability to take risks; confident and courageous.
Of a colour or design) having a strong, vivid, or clear appearance.
Of a person, action, or idea) impudent or presumptuous.
Of a typeface) printed in a thick, heavy type.
examples: She made a bold decision to quit her job.
The artist used bold colours in her painting.
It was a bold move to challenge the manager.
The important words are printed in bold.
